separate wrong-history rows from reset and zero-current controls

commands.name: projection_aware_boundary_outcome_gate_design
commands.command: Use M516 artifacts to design a projection-aware outcome gate before implementation.

decision_rule: M517 should admit M518 only if the next gate preserves projected obstacle geometry and classifies wrong-history no-effect separately from controller failure.
next_blocker: M518 should implement and run the projection-aware boundary outcome gate.
